description: Hand-written questions over eval/fixture_repo. Ground truth (expected_paths, required_facts) was authored from the fixture source by a human before any model output existed; no model-generated answers are used as references. required_facts is a list of groups; a group is satisfied when ANY of its case-insensitive regexes matches the answer. Questions with answerable=false have no supporting evidence in the fixture and must be answered with an abstention.
